content: Ampicillin Capsules, USP are available for oral administration in two dosage strengths: 250 mg and 500 mg. Each capsule contains ampicillin trihydrate, which is equivalent to the stated amount of ampicillin. The 250 mg capsules are white, opaque, hard gelatin capsules, imprinted with GG 850/GG 850 in black ink. They are supplied in bottles containing either 100 capsules (NDC 0781-2144-01) or 500 capsules (NDC 0781-2144-05). The 500 mg capsules are also white, opaque, hard gelatin capsules, imprinted with GG 851/GG 851 in black ink. They are supplied in bottles containing either 100 capsules (NDC 0781-2145-01) or 500 capsules (NDC 0781-2145-05). The product should be stored at a controlled room temperature of 20° to 25°C (68° to 77°F), as defined by the USP Controlled Room Temperature guidelines. It must be dispensed in a tightly sealed container to maintain its stability and efficacy. This product was manufactured in Austria by Sandoz GmbH and is distributed by Sandoz Inc., located in Princeton, NJ 08540. The most recent revision of this information was in November 2006.
